sourceFiles.analysis: Optional workspaceWait timestamp annotates a queued command; helpers inspect it; successful LOCAL_CLAIM removes it. No lease, approval, startedAt or result is granted by this field. Old Handoff/Retry prefixes have no local commands; Delivery Verification local claims have no competing holder and therefore never write this annotation.

canAcquireResourceLeases now tests whether resourceLeaseBlockerOwners is empty. Its legacy condition is the former legacyRows.some predicate and its typed condition is the former rows.some predicate, each excluding the same owner. Dedupe changes only explanatory owner multiplicity; transactional all-or-nothing admission is unchanged.

notifyResourceRelease groups the existing resources/workspace/typed-key notifications. Notifications are wake-ups to retry transactional qualification, not execution permits. No command planning, approval matching, journal settlement, process launch or cancellation guarantee changes.

sourceFiles.classification: intentional supervision interpretation outside old finite domains
sourceFiles.analysis: effectiveWork excludes queued commands bearing a wait observation, and supervision distinguishes resources from executing work and repair. Hard/repair deadlines still precede resource waiting, so no budget/window extension. No old graph emits SUPERVISE and its fixed clock stays at 0 before expiry; original safety/liveness properties are unchanged. New BT_Y114 and actual service/browser scenarios carry this behavior.
Adds blocker source room identity and waitingResources status. It does not widen any trusted mutation input or original publication contract.

sourceFiles.analysis: Current room blockers can explain actual conflicting old uncertain/unsafe holders using original source room/task/work/operation identity. coordinationSnapshot observes all persisted metadata and applies LocalRuntime.clean before supplying a lazy facilitator view. Operator/background/deletion trusted reconciliation wakes waiters only after an accepted LOCAL_RECONCILE; the current command still uses independent exact approval and resource reacquisition. No old abstract action invokes these new browser projections.

newDependency.classification: new conservative source dependency, excluded read-only branch
newDependency.analysis: Pure projection of room/task/work/operation status, startedAt, command argv/cwd/reason, task.reason, gate.question, leases and wait relationships. It does not include chat or artifact bodies and contains no mutation or authorization capability. Labels/command metadata are untrusted and runtime-cleaned by its service caller. The old finite graph slice never consumes this global view; adding its bytes to coverage binds the imported dependency without claiming a new proof.

Delivery local verification uses uncontended resource claims and all existing exact version/candidate/publication guards remain intact.
